name: CrewAI-Studio
notes: Python 3.12.15 (Dockerfile python:3.12.10-slim). No CI; setup installs the fully pinned requirements.txt (crewai 1.5.0, langchain-openai 1.1.14, langchain-anthropic 1.2.0, litellm 1.84.0, openai 2.26.0, anthropic 0.75.0, torch/docling...) plus pytest 8.4.2; the app is a Streamlit app in app/ (not a package; no reinstall: tests and smoke put app/ on sys.path from the copy). test_cmd = (1) the repo's own tests/ (tests/test_tool_ids.py, 21 tests; it sets DB_URL to a temp sqlite itself) and (2) a smoke: compileall app/, import llms, my_agent, my_task, my_crew, pg_crew_run, utils, then llms.load_secrets_fron_env() + llms.create_llm('OpenAI: gpt-4o-mini') and create_llm('Anthropic: claude-3-7-sonnet-20250219') with dummy keys (constructs crewai LLM / ChatAnthropic offline; Streamlit session_state works in bare mode). Counts are summed by parse_counts (21 + 9 = 30). Both runs identical; also 30 passed under sandbox-exec with outbound network denied. CrewAI telemetry disabled via CREWAI_TELEMETRY_OPT_OUT/OTEL_SDK_DISABLED.
